A214.facts: Verdict: attack likely. On the Siemens-controlled water process, the valve position command stopped matching what the controller normally commands for this water level, at 3.6 times the alarm level. The water level itself is normal: 54%, inside its normal range of 25% to 70%.
A214.explanation: A command to the valve was likely altered, possibly by unauthorized access to the controller, as the valve position commanded no longer aligns with the standard operation, despite the water level remaining within its normal range of 25% to 70%.
steps: Switch the affected pump or valve to manual and check the tank level directly.
Disconnect the controller from the internet and remote-access tools.
Change default and shared passwords on the controller and operator screens.
Compare the controller program with your last known-good copy.
Report to CISA and your local FBI field office.
